whatsapp.general: Hello JF Motores, I would like information about your equipment.

a.h2: Peace of mind and reliability in every engine.
a.p: One turn of the key. Four cylinders breathe in a 1-3-4-2 sequence, the exhaust lets out its first breath and the whole system comes alive.

b.p: Full load. Two pistons up, two down: a perfectly balanced crankshaft to keep the pump going where other engines give up.

c.p: Live technical exploded view: every part labelled. Tap any part to see its spare parts.

d.p: End of cycle: parts return to place, the block cools down and is ready for the next shift. That's how every workday ends — and how yours begins.

benefits.intro: Every JF unit leaves the workshop tested under real load. This is what you get from the very first start.

rows.p: Mining-grade cast blocks, bench-verified torque and tolerances checked part by part before shipping.
Flat torque curve from 1,200 rpm: the pump holds steady flow even with dense slurry and suspended solids.
Parts for your engine and pump set with compatibility information. Get quotes and arrange everything on WhatsApp.
Calibrated to operate above 2,500 m: compensated injection, cold start and oversized cooling.

sections.p: JF Motores ({legalName}, Tax ID {nit}), with its workshop at {address}, is responsible for processing the personal data collected on this site, in accordance with Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013.
Name, email, phone or WhatsApp, country, and information about the quotes you request (product, date and channel). Also technical browsing data such as language and device.
To handle your quotes and purchases, give you access to your account, track the equipment you buy, improve the site and, only if you authorize it, send you news and offers.

You may access, update, correct and request deletion of your data, revoke this authorization and file complaints with Colombia's Superintendence of Industry and Commerce. You can update your details from My account.
Message us on WhatsApp at {phone} with your name, email and request. We will reply within the legal deadlines (10 business days for inquiries and 15 for claims).
Your data is stored on servers with restricted access. Passwords are stored encrypted and nobody can see them. We keep data while the business relationship exists or as required by law.
